title: Sega Smash Pack
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Ecco the Dolphin, Golden Axe, Sonic Spinball
Pick one of the three games from the menu; each plays like its Mega Drive original

rows: underwater adventure; Golden Axe: beat 'em up; Sonic Spinball: pinball
magic potions boost the magic attack
hit bumpers and targets to open the boss; Ecco: avoid jellyfish and sharks

widgets.text:
Pick a game from the menu
Each game runs separately from the pack's menu and keeps its own options

rows: potions (from the thieves) power magic; Ecco: air meter refilled at the surface

widgets.text:
3 games
Three Mega Drive games on one cartridge

rows: three heroes (Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, Gilius Thunderhead)

widgets.text:
Per-game progress
Ecco the Dolphin uses passwords; Golden Axe and Sonic Spinball are played as runs
